headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 23, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 11 and allowing 3 earned runs. Dominic Smith led the Padres with a 1-HR, 3-RBI performance.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several key players sidelined. The Toronto Blue Jays' Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Patrick Corbin has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 22, 2026, with a left teres major strain. Jonatan Clase has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 21, 2026, with left plantar fasciitis.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, with the Pittsburgh Pirates acquiring right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded right-handed pitcher Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for right-handed pitcher Max Martin. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Braves Edge Padres in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 6-5 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 11 and allowing 3 earned runs. Dominic Smith led the Padres with a 1-HR, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 3-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged out the Cleveland Guardians 3-1, securing a crucial win. Patrick Bailey led the Twins' offense with a home run, driving in one run.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Rays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 3-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Shane Bieber earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Take Down Cardinals 10-6**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a 10-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, led by Tyler Locklear's impressive 3-hit, 1-home run performance. Brandon Pfaadt earned the win for the Diamondbacks.

top_news.title: **Addison Barger Shifts to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Marinaccio in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres, receiving future considerations in return.
